column1: 13 analysed candidates are the historical top-25 ranked designations restricted to n>10, not all Tier1 designations with n>10.
rank is the full-population rank, not a consecutive rank within the 13. Tie-breaks follow the original script: tier, carbapenemase count, ESBL count, convergence count, genome count.
Country counts exclude unknown geography. ESBL uses the union of both acquired ESBL fields. Counts/proportions were not rounded before scoring; displayed percentages have one decimal.
Only the highest qualifying award within each component is added; the 13 component scores sum to a maximum of 34.
median_replicon_family_count preserves the legacy column name but counts distinct complete PlasmidFinder replicon designations, not collapsed Inc families, complete plasmids or plasmid molecules.
One Health scoring requires both source groups in an ST and ESBL/carbapenemase somewhere in that ST, not resistant genomes in both source groups or shared genes/plasmids.
The Tier1 overlap trigger instead uses specified clinical genes (CTX-M-15, SHV-12 or KPC/NDM/OXA/VIM/IMP prefixes in the relevant carbapenemase field), and n>=3.
Virulence uses the reported fields as in the original framework, including incomplete/unknown calls; no phenotype or clinical-risk validation is claimed.
Country/MLST/source breadth are descriptive; correlated scoring components are not independent evidence. Candidate status does not prove transmission or clinical harm.
